descriptionChirho: A human male or person in general; the primary sense of אִישׁ covering individual men, groups of men, 'men of X' construct chains, and generic references to a person or someone, across all grammatical inflections, prepositions, and conjunctions.
A woman's husband or spouse, typically occurring with feminine possessive suffixes (her husband, your husband) or in contexts explicitly referring to the marital relationship.
Male as a biological sex category, used in contrast with נְקֵבָה (female), referring to the sex of humans or animals rather than to a specific person.
Distributive or indefinite pronominal use meaning 'each, each one, everyone, anyone, no one,' functioning as a pronoun rather than a noun designating a specific man.
